R4b_hypoxia_signature.why: R4 showed the annotation-based hypoxia_responsive set does not respond to hypoxia in any positive-control dataset, and a gene-level look at the OSD-38 BRIC-PDFU vs closed-container contrast showed ADH1 (AT1G77120) and PDC1 (AT4G33070) up about 6-fold (padj < 0.001), which a 6-gene fermentation-set mean dilutes. This addendum replaces the uninformative set with an empirical hypoxia signature from independent data. It was written after those two observations and is reported as such.
R4b_hypoxia_signature.signature: GSE14502 core hypoxia-up genes: limma (R4) log2FC > 1 and BH q < 0.05 in BOTH the shoot and the root total-mRNA contrasts
R4b_hypoxia_signature.also: the matching hypoxia-down signature (log2FC < -1, q < 0.05 in both), tested the same way
tested_in: OSD-38 BRIC-PDFU vs closed container (GeneLab Wald, T12 layer rna_hardware)
R4b_hypoxia_signature.null: genomic rotation, 10000 offsets, seed 20261030, signed set statistic; BH over the rows of this addendum
R4b_hypoxia_signature.descriptive: ADH1 and PDC1 log2FC and adjusted p in each tested contrast
R4b_hypoxia_signature.reading: a hypoxia-up signature that rises in BRIC-PDFU vs container is evidence of lower O2 in the BRIC on the ground; the T12 hardware verdicts stay as pre-registered
